title: Making Pancakes with Dad

lines.text: Good morning, Nina! Are you hungry?

Mix everything. Don't use your hands! Use a spoon.

It's fine. Now I'm going to cook the pancakes in the pan. Please get the honey.
Honey, plates and two glasses. Breakfast is ready!
